chapter.title: Add-on evaluation suite
chapter.para: The addon artifact is org.apache.opennlp.addons:addons-eval. It holds the evaluation suite of the add-ons: tests that run the production evaluators of each add-on on downloaded data, skip when the data is absent, and hold the measured figures against documented regression floors when it is present. It mirrors the opennlp-eval-tests module of OpenNLP core and depends on the add-ons it evaluates, so it is the last add-on module in the build.

section.title: Locating the data
section.para: EvalData resolves two directories. The model directory is the .opennlp directory below the OPENNLP_DOWNLOAD_HOME system property, else the environment variable of the same name, else the user's home, which is where core's DownloadUtil stores downloaded models. The eval root is the opennlp.addons.eval.dir system property, else the OPENNLP_ADDONS_EVAL_DIR environment variable, else the eval directory below the model directory. A blank setting counts as unset. Each evaluation reads one subdirectory of the root: vector-search, sentencepiece, ud, coref/ontogum and coref/gap; the module README lists the files each one expects.

The eval tests use JUnit assumptions, so a missing directory or file skips the test with a message naming the path, and a plain build never fails for want of data. When an evaluation runs, it writes one tab-separated report per evaluation under target/eval-reports through EvalReport, with the columns metric, dataset, model, value, threshold and pass, and prints one summary line per metric.

section.title: The evaluations

listitem.para: VectorSearchEvalTest runs SearchEvaluator of embeddings-core over a static embedding model and a normalized passage corpus at 4 bits and depth 10, as the EvalVectorSearch command does, and records index fidelity, half-passage and definition-to-headword retrieval and throughput.
SentencePieceParityEvalTest encodes the reference fixtures of real SentencePiece models with SentencePieceTokenizer of subword and requires exact parity of pieces, ids, spans and normalized forms.

BilstmPosEvalTest trains the BiLSTM tagger of neural-postag on a Universal Dependencies treebank with the default settings and scores its UPOS word accuracy on the test split with core's POSEvaluator.

OntoGumEvalTest reads OntoGUM or CorefUD documents with ConlluCorefDocumentStream, predicts entities and chunks with core's document annotators, resolves them with the rule-based CorefAnnotator and scores the CoNLL average with CorefScorer.
GapEvalTest scores pronoun resolution on the GAP development split with every layer predicted, reporting F1 overall and by the pronoun's gender.

section.para: The thresholds are regression floors well below the figures the add-on chapters report; the report files are the measurement. Run the suite with mvn -pl addons-eval verify -Dopennlp.addons.eval.dir=/path/to/eval, or one evaluation with -Dtest=<name>. The continuous integration workflow caches the .opennlp directory, including the eval root below it, keyed on the hash of .github/models-manifest.txt, so downloaded models and data survive between builds until that manifest changes.
